title: Settings
description: Configure your organization and the portal.

status.pending: {count, plural, one {# registration awaiting review} other {# registrations awaiting review}}
status.leaveTypes: {active, plural, =0 {No active leave types} one {# active leave type} other {# active leave types}}
status.fields: {count, plural, one {# active form field} other {# active form fields}}
status.withoutWorkflow: {count, plural, one {# active request type has no workflow} other {# active request types have no workflow}}
status.workflows: {count, plural, one {# workflow configured} other {# workflows configured}}
status.sla: {count} of {total} request types have an SLA
status.imports: {count, plural, one {# import} other {# imports}} · last on {date}
status.audit: {count, plural, =0 {No events in the last 7 days} one {# event in the last 7 days} other {# events in the last 7 days}}

health.title: Configuration health
health.passed: {count, plural, one {# passed check} other {# passed checks}}

companyName.title: Company name
companyName.issue: Add the company name used on the portal, letters and emails.

logo.title: Company logo
logo.ok: Uploaded and shown across the portal.
logo.issue: Upload a logo for the sidebar, sign-in page and certificates.

hrEmail.title: HR contact email
hrEmail.ok: Shown to employees who need help.
hrEmail.issue: Add an HR email so pending or locked-out users know whom to contact.

legal.title: Commercial registration
legal.issue: Add the commercial registration number for official letters.

certificateAssets.title: Stamp & signature
certificateAssets.issue: Upload the company stamp and authorized signature, and name the signatory.

departments.title: Departments
departments.issue: Create departments before adding or importing employees.

jobTitles.title: Job titles
jobTitles.ok: At least one active job title.
jobTitles.issue: Create job titles before adding or importing employees.

locations.title: Locations
locations.issue: Add your offices or sites to track where employees work.

hrAdmin.title: HR Admin assigned
hrAdmin.ok: At least one active HR Admin.
hrAdmin.issue: No active user holds the HR Admin role. Assign one so HR work doesn’t depend on the Super Admin.

workflows.title: Approval workflows
workflows.ok: Every active request type has a workflow.
workflows.issue: {count, plural, one {# active request type has} other {# active request types have}} no approval workflow.

holidays.title: Public holidays {year}
holidays.ok: Holidays are set for leave and SLA calculations.
holidays.issue: Add this year’s public holidays so leave days and SLAs are counted correctly.

email.title: Email delivery
email.issue: No email provider is configured. Emails are logged but not sent — set RESEND_API_KEY or SMTP settings.

setup.title: Setup wizard
setup.issue: The guided setup hasn’t been completed yet.

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Company identity, contact details, legal information, regional settings and the working schedule.
organization.readOnly: You can view these settings but not change them.
organization.logoLocked: Only administrators with full settings access can change the logo.
organization.footerHint: Changes apply across the portal as soon as you save.

sections.identityHint: How the company appears on the portal, letters and emails.
sections.contactHint: Address and the contact details shown to employees.
sections.legalHint: Registration details printed on official documents.
sections.regionalHint: Currency, time zone, default language and fiscal year.
sections.scheduleHint: Used to count leave days and request SLAs in business days.

fields.logoHint: Shown in the sidebar, sign-in page and certificates. A square image with a transparent background works best.
fields.namesHint: Enter the name in at least one language; the other language falls back to it.
fields.hrEmailHint: Shown to users who need help, e.g. while their account awaits approval.
fields.commercialRegistrationHint: As printed on the CR certificate.
fields.timezoneHint: Used for dates, SLA deadlines and scheduled alerts.
fields.defaultLanguageHint: For users who haven’t chosen a language yet.
fields.fiscalYearStartHint: Used by reports that follow the fiscal year.
fields.weekendDaysHint: A day can be a working day or a weekend day, not both.

summary.workingDays: {count, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}}
summary.weekendDays: {count, plural, one {# weekend day} other {# weekend days}}

validation.phone: Enter a valid phone number, e.g. +966 11 000 0000
validation.workingDays: Select at least one working day
validation.dayOverlap: A day can’t be both a working day and a weekend day
validation.workHours: The workday must end after it starts

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Portal name, logo, colors, sign-in page, company stamp and authorized signature.
branding.readOnly: You can view the branding but not change it.
branding.adminOnly: Only administrators with full settings access can change public images.
branding.footerHint: Saved colors apply to everyone immediately. Images apply as soon as they’re uploaded.

sections.identityHint: The name and logo shown in the sidebar, browser tab and emails.
sections.colorsHint: Primary color for buttons, links and highlights; secondary color for accents.
sections.loginHint: The brand panel users see before signing in.
sections.certificatesHint: Stamp, signature and signatory printed on certificates and HR letters.

fields.logoHint: Square PNG or SVG with a transparent background works best.
fields.primaryColorHint: Buttons, links, active navigation and focus rings.
fields.secondaryColorHint: Accents, highlights and the active navigation indicator.
fields.loginImageHint: Landscape photo behind the brand panel; it’s darkened automatically for legibility.
fields.privateHint: The stamp and signature are stored privately and are only used when HR issues documents.

colors.similarWarning: The two colors are very similar, so accents won’t stand out. Choose a more distinct secondary color.
colors.contrastWarning: One of the colors has low contrast on white backgrounds. Text and icons in that color may be hard to read.
colors.contrastTooltip: Contrast on white: {surface}:1 · text on this color: {fill}:1

notes.shell: Sidebar, header, buttons and badges use the primary and secondary colors. Dark mode shades are derived automatically.
notes.login: Title and subtitle fall back to the defaults when left empty.
notes.letter: Company details come from Settings › Organization. Templates decide where each element appears.

image.removeDescription: The file is deleted and the default appearance is used instead.
